2027 Rules for candidates: course types not funded

subject_rule: Study in almost any discipline at graduate level at a British university; whole course types are excluded (professional degrees in medicine, dentistry, veterinary science and law, MBA, postgraduate diplomas and certificates, part-time and distance learning), per the 2027 Rules.

notes: The rows are institutions, not courses: the Commission publishes a list of institutions and a course-type rule, with no catalogue of subjects. The page says that if an institution is missing, applicants can contact the Commission.
The same institution list is recorded under master's and doctorate because the page does not split it by level; the Open University is marked research degrees only on the page.
Doctoral funding is for up to three years; master's for one or two years (Marshall site).
The list contains specialist art, music and drama institutions and several University of London institutes; some may not run courses that meet the Rules.
fetch_problems: The Marshall course search is an interactive tool and was not used; the list was read from the institutions page through a page summary, which may have shortened or merged entries.
